name: What is the process for cabinet installation with Frasheski Construction?
description: Our process includes consultation, quoting, scheduled installation with home protection, and a final walkthrough for satisfaction.

mainEntity.name: What is the process for cabinet installation with Frasheski Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our cabinet installation process begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, budget, and functional needs. We then provide a detailed quote and timeline. Once approved, we schedule the installation, ensuring proper protection of your home during the process. Our experienced team meticulously installs your cabinets, ensuring they are level, secure, and perfectly aligned. We conclude with a final walkthrough to ensure your complete satisfaction with the finished product.
